name: Daisy Ring
design_intent:
MEADOW MILE #9 — the circuit's first RADIAL shape (atoll-lite): four rim islands wrap a central void WELL, with two elevated bubblegum side-shelves (+520) and one low central spring throne over the well. Combat wraps around the ring instead of running along a line; every rim overlooks the same maw, so a boost across the well is the signature play. Calm, symmetric, no hazard.

GEOMETRY (centred x=0): BASE-LEFT (trampoline x-1150..-320 top1120) / BASE-RIGHT (trampoline x320..1150 top1120) flank the WELL (gap x-320..320 = 640px, open to the void). TOP-LEFT rim (bubblegum x-1150..-320 top600, +520 above base) / TOP-RIGHT rim (bubblegum x320..1150 top600) form the ring's upper arc over a 640px top-well gap. Two mid SIDE-SHELVES out at the sides (bubblegum x-2000..-1460 / x1460..2000, top600, +520 above base). One low central THRONE (spring x-180..180 top860 h48) hovers over the well mouth, +260 above base but offset over the 640px well so it is a boosted-arc prize. Full-width lethal void (rim y1260); bounds -2540..2540 keep side-shelf outer edges ~540px inside the side blast; bottom y1960 = 712px recovery under base, deep column under the throne.

MOVEMENT (Tuning.gd: trampoline apex 270 / bubblegum 180 / spring 480; zero-boost drift ~395 tramp / ~320 bubblegum / ~527 spring max; normal_boost_max 760 crosses 640 in <1s @ ~26 fuel; super 2800 clears all). Traversal WRAPS; every neighbour move is flight-required:
- WELL crossing BASE-LEFT<->BASE-RIGHT: x-320..x320 = 640px over the well. > 527 and >> 395. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; miss = fall into the well. Verb: FLY.
- TOP-WELL crossing TOP-LEFT<->TOP-RIGHT: 640px over the well mouth. > 527. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- CLIMB BASE->TOP rim or BASE->SIDE-SHELF: 520px vertical (1120->600). Trampoline apex 270 reaches y850 -> 250px short. JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- REACH the central THRONE: hovers over the OPEN 640px well; only a boosted arc lands it, an under-shot drops straight down the column. Verb: FLY.
- RECOVER: base bottom (1248) to bottom blast (1960) = 712px recovery sky (>= 650); a fall into the well drops down the column and a fuelled player boosts back out. Verb: FLY.
- No bounce route wraps the ring or reaches the throne, so flight is required to move at all. Vertical AND horizontal distance are load-bearing.
